title: Spec check: a batch readiness check before a wave, answered in one sitting

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Retrospective R2 (docs/review-2026-10-25-relay-retrospective.md). Orchestrator preflight found real spec gaps (S32, S97, S07, S33, S35, S45) but asked one slice at a time, and runs waiting on the owner took 18-19 h against a 20 min median. adj 164 (roles.spec-check, open; recommended batch-spec-check).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/roles/prompts/spec-check.md` (new): read-only; per slice returns ready or structured owner questions (S111 shape).
- `internal/roles/roles.go`: register the role.
- `internal/cli/wave.go` and `internal/tui/waves.go`: run the check on the proposed wave; only ready items can be approved.
- `internal/daemon/runs.go`: the check runs as a read-only job.
- `docs/design.md:151-181` (Wave lifecycle): a check step between Suggest and Lineup.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestSpecCheckMarksReadyAndQuestions: a fake vendor report with one ready slice and one with two questions yields one ready item and two owner questions.
- TestWaveApproveRefusesUncheckedItem: an item with open spec questions cannot start.
- TestSpecCheckIsReadOnly: a tree change by the role stops it (role.readonly-fingerprint).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Wait for adj 164 and S111 (question shape). Answers go into the slice spec with slicer edit and, for design points, into adj via the S28 path. Model and effort come from a new matrix row (proposed sonnet medium).

From S111 (2026-10-25): report.go parses one Question block per Owner needed section; a spec check with several questions needs a multi-block parse.

adj 164 is decided (batch-spec-check); S111 has landed. Owner decisions (2026-10-26 session, AskUserQuestion): (1) model sonnet medium. slicer has no spec-check role until s392, so add a matrix row with role reviewer and note 'Spec check row', named by a matrix rule as S117 does for the UI pass, never a reviewer or gate fallback; switch to slicer's role when s392 lands. (2) In Waves, pressing l runs the check for ticked items not yet checked against their current spec; ready items launch, the others show their questions in one sitting and launch once answered. (3) ork records answers by appending an 'Owner decisions (date)' paragraph to the slice's Implement section with slicer edit --append; a question with a Decision key also goes to adj through the S28 path. Depends on S117 (rule-named rows).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./...; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint. UI slice: UI pass (r14).
